LLM-driven. Buys recent winners that are still trending. Region-agnostic
bias — the same prompt runs against S&P 500 in the US pipeline and against
UK + EU blue chips in the UK/EU pipeline. The LLM is told the universe is
whatever's been pre-filtered for it and adapts to the regime.

executed.thesis: Reconciled from Alpaca portfolio (slot 1) — original ledger entry missing (likely an entry-run timeout or smart-merge race). Daily exit will close this normally.
executed.outcome_notes: Price drifted steadily lower from entry, with no recovery sufficient to offset the opening gap, and the scheduled exit captured a fully realised loss rather than a partial one. Because this was a reconciled position with no original entry record, there is no momentum signal to validate — the thesis itself is unknown, making causation unattributable.
executed.risks_observed: The missing ledger entry meant no stop-loss level was registered, leaving the position exposed for the full session with only the EOD scheduled exit as a safety net. Reconciled positions are a structural blind spot: they carry live risk without any of the entry-time risk parameters the strategy depends on.

executed.thesis: Reconciled from Alpaca portfolio (slot 1) — original ledger entry missing (likely an entry-run timeout or smart-merge race). Daily exit will close this normally.
executed.outcome_notes: HIVE declined through the session and closed near the day's low, with the scheduled exit executing into continued weakness rather than a stabilisation. As with the other reconciled slot, there is no recoverable entry signal to assess — the loss reflects unknown exposure rather than a failed thesis.
executed.risks_observed: Both reconciled positions on this date lost roughly 3.5%, suggesting correlated intraday selling pressure across small-cap / speculative names; holding two such positions simultaneously amplified the drawdown. The broader pattern of entry-run timeouts or smart-merge races producing untracked positions is a systemic risk that compounds on down days when reconciliation is most likely to surface positions already underwater.

executed.thesis: Nvidia earnings confirmed $2B surge in agentic AI chip demand with ARM architecture at the center — Bernstein $300 PT and +3% premarket gap signal institutional buying pressure continuing intraday. Strongest momentum name in the candidate set with volume confirmation.
executed.outcome_notes: The Nvidia spillover thesis held intraday — price moved cleanly toward the Bernstein $300 PT with no meaningful reversion, confirming institutional follow-through rather than a fade. Scheduled exit captured the bulk of the move; there was no adverse price action that warranted an early close.
executed.risks_observed: The trade was entirely dependent on a single macro catalyst (Nvidia earnings read-through), leaving it exposed to any intraday narrative reversal in semiconductors. The scheduled exit structure left no mechanism to extend the hold had momentum continued — and with the $300 PT still overhead at close, that was a real opportunity cost.

executed.thesis: Back-to-back analyst upgrades (BTIG $76, Oppenheimer Outperform $85) on the same day as 5d +12.46% momentum creates a fresh catalyst that can extend the move — cybersecurity's defensive positioning buffers against tech macro headwinds.
executed.outcome_notes: The analyst upgrade catalyst did not generate fresh buying — price drifted lower from entry, consistent with the upgrades being already absorbed into the prior 5-day run. Scheduled exit meant the position held through the full session with no mechanism to cut early.
executed.risks_observed: Entering a name up 12%+ in five days on analyst upgrades is structurally a buy-the-news setup where the easy money is likely behind; there were no intraday signals at entry that new demand was arriving. The absence of a trailing stop or hard stop converted what should have been a defined-risk trade into a slow bleed to close — correlated with ARM in the AI/tech complex, the basket also lacked sector diversification.

executed.thesis: Goldman Sachs PT raise to $207 (+15% upside) lands directly on a macro regime where US refiners are running at multi-year utilization highs with record product exports — energy sector leadership + analyst upgrade is a durable 2-day catalyst.
executed.outcome_notes: The analyst upgrade failed to act as a near-term price catalyst — PSX sold off through the stop without any recovery attempt, suggesting the Goldman PT raise was either already priced in or overwhelmed by short-term headwinds in refining margins or crude spreads. The "2-day catalyst" window never opened; price moved directionally against the thesis from the outset.
executed.risks_observed: Analyst PT raises are a weak momentum trigger in energy names where crack-spread volatility and macro sentiment regularly dominate single-stock news flow. A stop placed 2.9% below entry left limited room for noise in a sector with intraday ranges that can easily exceed that threshold, and there was no volume or technical confirmation that accumulation was actually underway at entry.

executed.thesis: MACD histogram +19.757 is the most powerful building-momentum signal in the candidate set, paired with 5d +15.55% and strong volume — B of A maintaining Buy with $1400 PT provides a 14% upside anchor supporting continued institutional accumulation.
executed.outcome_notes: The scheduled exit captured a clean continuation of the pre-existing momentum — price advanced steadily from entry without requiring stop management, consistent with institutional accumulation absorbing supply. The MACD signal held its predictive value for the duration of the hold window.
executed.risks_observed: Entering after a 15.5% five-day run means a meaningful portion of the move was already behind; any negative surprise during the hold (guidance cut, macro risk-off) would have faced little technical support between entry and a distant stop. At this price point, a single high-conviction name dominates basket notional, and correlation with broad tech sentiment is a tail risk the BofA PT anchor does nothing to hedge.

executed.thesis: Goldman Sachs raises PT to $57 this morning while price holds above both MAs with RSI 63.5 and MACD histogram +1.792 — strongest momentum setup in the candidate set with a fresh analyst catalyst aligning with energy sector tailwinds.
executed.outcome_notes: The GS price-target raise acted as a genuine catalyst — price moved directly toward take-profit with no meaningful retracement, suggesting the upgrade attracted fresh institutional buying rather than just triggering a momentary spike. RSI at entry (63.5) left enough room before overbought territory for the move to develop cleanly, and the MACD histogram strength confirmed momentum was not already exhausted.
executed.risks_observed: ENPH carries substantial policy sensitivity as a solar name — an adverse rate or subsidy headline mid-session could have reversed the catalyst effect before take-profit was reached. Single-analyst-upgrade setups are also prone to fast fading if the broader energy sector stalled; the trade had no fundamental floor below the technical support levels.

executed.thesis: 20d +37.64% trend intact with price above both MAs, but RSI 74.2 and decelerating MACD histogram (+0.219) limit conviction — tight stop to exit quickly if the momentum stalls.
executed.outcome_notes: Price pushed through to take-profit despite entering with a nearly exhausted momentum signal — the 20-day trend's underlying strength was sufficient to overcome the RSI overextension and the near-flat MACD histogram. The tight-stop protective design proved unnecessary, but the trade's success was more attributable to trend persistence than to entry-point quality.
executed.risks_observed: An RSI of 74.2 at entry meant almost no buffer before a reversal would have looked technically justified to other participants; a single risk-off hour could have swept the tight stop for a loss on what resolved as a winner. The decelerating histogram was a real warning sign that the best of the move may already have been captured by prior holders, leaving this entry exposed to a mean-reversion snapback with little margin for error.

executed.thesis: Textbook post-earnings momentum entry: Q4 beat with strong FY27 revenue guidance, volume at 1.40x average confirming institutional buying, Needham reiterating Buy at $120 (~32% above current). The only candidate with all momentum signals aligned — catalyst, volume, trend, and analyst support simultaneously present.
executed.outcome_notes: Price failed to hold post-earnings gains and reversed sharply through the stop, suggesting the initial volume spike was distribution rather than accumulation. The entry thesis did not hold — institutional buying did not sustain, and the Needham price target provided no near-term price support as sellers dominated.
executed.risks_observed: Single-name concentration with no correlated hedge meant the full drawdown landed on one position; the 1.40x volume confirmation proved ambiguous in hindsight — elevated volume on a beat can signal both entry and exit by larger holders. A wider stop relative to the earnings-day range would have been stopped out regardless, flagging that earnings-momentum entries carry gap-risk that standard stop placement underestimates.

archived.description:
LLM-driven. Buys recent winners that are still trending. Region-agnostic
bias — the same prompt runs against S&P 500 in the US pipeline and against
UK + EU blue chips in the UK/EU pipeline. The LLM is told the universe is
whatever's been pre-filtered for it and adapts to the regime.

executed.thesis: SOXL.MI (3x long semiconductor ETF) is the sole actionable momentum name in the candidate list — +51.67% 5-day with RSI 68.9 (below overbought threshold), strongly above both MAs, and positive MACD. Macro backdrop explicitly supports semiconductors via unbroken AI capex narrative and yield pullback tailwind; stop placed at -10% (just below 1 ATR) to allow intraday noise room given the ETF's structural volatility.
executed.outcome_notes: Price reversed sharply intraday against the long, falling ~14% from entry before the scheduled close — implying roughly a 4–5% drop in the underlying semiconductor index on the day, amplified 3x. The thesis that momentum would extend after a +51% 5-day run did not hold; buying into a near-vertical move made the position immediately vulnerable to any mean-reversion trigger. Critically, the stated -10% stop was not the actual exit — the scheduled close was, meaning the position was held ~4 percentage points through the intended stop level with no intervention.
executed.risks_observed: The stop either was not wired up, was overridden by the scheduled-exit logic, or gapped through without fill — whichever the case, a core safety net failed, and the loss exceeded the pre-defined maximum. Entering a 3x levered instrument as the *sole* candidate in the basket means zero diversification and no offsetting exposure to absorb the drawdown; a single bad day in semis produced the full portfolio hit. Entering after a +51% 5-day run on a leveraged ETF carries implicit mean-reversion and volatility-decay risk that the RSI-below-70 filter does not capture.

executed.thesis: Best setup in the set: fresh earnings beat with profit upgrade drives a 14.6% 5-day run while RSI 64.7 and above-average volume signal the trend is still healthy, not overextended. Earnings continuation is the cleanest momentum catalyst available today.
executed.outcome_notes: Price drifted up by a single tick and was held to the scheduled close, suggesting the intraday momentum was effectively flat after entry — the 14.6% 5-day run had already absorbed most of the earnings catalyst before the position was opened. The exit reason being scheduled rather than a target confirms no meaningful continuation occurred on the day.
executed.risks_observed: Entering late in a multi-day post-earnings run is the core risk here: by the time RSI and volume confirm, the easy money is often gone and the remaining upside is thin. A position this size relative to the move also means transaction costs erode most of the gain, so the effective edge was near-zero.

executed.thesis: The 3.41× volume surge on full-year earnings results is the key differentiator versus recent high-RSI failures — institutional conviction is visible in the tape. MACD firmly positive and both MAs confirmed; tight stop set below today's range to manage RSI 72.8 risk.
executed.outcome_notes: The stock faded from entry through the close despite the volume-backed thesis, indicating the institutional buying flagged in the tape was not sustained intraday — price action reversed the morning strength and the position was carried to a scheduled exit rather than stopped out. The RSI-72.8 risk flagged at entry materialised as a mean-reversion headwind rather than being contained by the 'tight stop' mentioned in the thesis.
executed.risks_observed: The scheduled exit overriding the stated tight stop is the critical failure mode to audit: either the stop was never placed, was too wide to trigger, or was abandoned — any of these undermines the risk management logic. At the basket level, holding two single-day momentum longs into a scheduled close with no dynamic exit on the loser concentrates downside in the weaker name and caps asymmetry on both sides.

executed.thesis: Cleanest momentum trade in the list — Infineon's +11%/+34.5% 5d/20d returns, non-overbought RSI (65.9), and strongly positive MACD reflect genuine demand for power semiconductors in AI data-centre buildouts; stop set at ~2x ATR below close, target at ~3x ATR.
executed.outcome_notes: Price moved against the position before recovering to the exit level, suggesting the stop was either triggered or the system exited on the partial recovery rather than holding for target. The AI data-centre demand narrative remained intact structurally, but the near-term action implies either profit-taking off the recent run or broader semiconductor sector rotation on the day — not a thesis invalidation.
executed.risks_observed: The +34.5% 20-day move meant significant embedded gains in the float; any macro wobble or sector rotation can flush late momentum entrants even when the thesis is sound. The missing entry price ($0.00) is a data integrity gap that makes it impossible to verify whether the stop was sized correctly relative to realised volatility on the day.

executed.thesis: ABN AMRO just beat Q1 forecasts with analyst upgrades following; +11% 5d with accelerating MACD histogram and yield curve steepening providing a structural NIM tailwind for European bank margins — fundamental catalyst reinforcing the technical trend.
executed.outcome_notes: The trade exited at a loss despite the price recovering, indicating the recovery was incomplete — the exit was taken on the bounce rather than at breakeven or target. European bank momentum is highly sensitive to intraday macro signals (rate prints, ECB commentary), and any reversal in short-end rates or credit spreads on the day would have immediately pressured NIM-driven names regardless of the Q1 catalyst.
executed.risks_observed: All three basket positions were in trending, recently strong sectors simultaneously — semiconductors, banks, and consumer staples — meaning a broad risk-off intraday move would hit all legs at once with no natural hedge. ABN specifically adds FX exposure (EUR/GBP) that is unaccounted for in the exit price, which may have contributed to the sterling-denominated loss even if the local price recovered.

executed.thesis: British American Tobacco is the clearest expression of the macro view's Consumer Staples defensive bid — +17% 20d, above both MAs, strong MACD momentum; position sized below max given RSI at 70.0 approaching overbought.
executed.outcome_notes: RSI was flagged at exactly 70.0 at entry, and the recovered exit with a loss is consistent with a brief overbought pullback that failed to fully retrace — the defensive/staples bid provided some cushion but not enough to prevent a negative close. The smaller loss relative to the other two legs suggests the reduced position sizing on overbought concern functioned as intended.
executed.risks_observed: At RSI 70.0, any catalyst for profit-taking (currency move, sector rotation into risk-on) creates asymmetric downside for late momentum entries; the strategy has no mechanism to distinguish between a healthy consolidation and a trend reversal at that signal level. Basket-level, all three trades sharing a 'recovered but still negative' outcome on the same date points to a common intraday driver — worth checking whether a single macro event (e.g. USD/EUR move, risk-off spike) explains the simultaneous drawdown across uncorrelated sectors.

executed.thesis: Strongest 5-day return among non-overbought candidates (+14.18%), rising volume (1.14x), and RSI 68.9 leaves room before the danger zone; defensive tobacco is directly aligned with the macro stagflationary rotation favouring consumer staples over rate-sensitives.
executed.outcome_notes: Scheduled close returned exactly zero, meaning price went nowhere from entry to exit — the 5-day momentum in BATS.L had no intraday continuation on the entry session. The defensive-rotation catalyst was either already fully priced at entry or lacked a fresh trigger to push it further on the day.
executed.risks_observed: Entering a name already up 14%+ over five days on a session that delivered flat price action is a warning sign that momentum was exhausted at the point of entry; the scheduled-exit structure means the position couldn't benefit from any multi-day follow-through while still bearing overnight gap risk. All four basket positions closed flat on the same day, suggesting a systemic timing issue rather than a stock-specific one.

executed.thesis: Top 5-day return in the entire candidate set (+14.36%) with price extended well above both MAs and expanding MACD histogram; RSI 74.2 is borderline overbought so stop is set at 1.5× ATR to protect against mean-reversion while the trend runs.
executed.outcome_notes: Zero P&L on a scheduled close; ITRK.L entered with the highest-ranked 5-day return in the set and an RSI already at 74.2, and price action on the entry day produced no extension whatsoever. The momentum signal appears to have been lagging rather than leading — the move had run before entry.
executed.risks_observed: An RSI of 74.2 is the clearest mean-reversion risk in this basket and a scheduled (likely same-day) close window gives insufficient time for trend momentum to overcome the overbought condition; the 1.5× ATR stop was appropriately defensive but the reward setup requires immediate continuation that didn't arrive. This was the highest-risk entry in the basket on the overbought dimension.

executed.thesis: Highest volume ratio in the set (1.79×) confirms institutional accumulation on the back of a Q1 earnings beat and analyst estimate upgrades; RSI 68.0 with a healthy MACD histogram provides clean technical backing for continuation.
executed.outcome_notes: Flat exit at scheduled close; the high volume ratio (1.79×) that justified an institutional-accumulation read did not translate into price continuation on the entry day, suggesting the Q1 earnings catalyst had already been absorbed by the market prior to entry. Post-earnings momentum entries are sensitive to exactly this timing risk.
executed.risks_observed: ABN.AS introduces European financials exposure that behaves differently from the UK consumer and industrials names in the same basket — credit spread widening or ECB commentary can move it independently and in the opposite direction. The earnings-beat thesis has a short shelf life; entering days after the catalyst leaves only technical momentum to carry the trade, which failed here.

executed.thesis: Robust 20-day trend (+16.62%) with above-average volume (1.43×) and RSI 66.3 leaving meaningful headroom before overbought; wider stop accounts for the larger ATR-relative spread typical of lower-priced shares while the 2:1 reward ratio keeps expected value positive.
executed.outcome_notes: Scheduled close at entry price with no movement captured; the strong 20-day trend in CPG.L at a £0.32 handle meant the bid-ask spread likely consumed any marginal intraday drift, and the entry session produced no directional push to overcome that friction. The trend signal was real but the holding window was too short to express it.
executed.risks_observed: At £0.32 per share, the spread is a material drag on the stated 2:1 reward ratio — the effective entry is worse than the mid-price and the effective exit is worse still, meaning the break-even threshold is structurally higher than the model assumes. The wider ATR-adjusted stop needed for low-priced shares also limits position sizing, reducing this name's contribution to basket returns even when the directional call is correct.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI pinned at 99.9 with 0.10× volume — price is a stale artifact of a single illiquid print, not a tradeable level; mean reversion is the only credible outcome if real volume returns.
uncommitted.reflection: Illiquid stale print held flat; no real volume returned to trigger the expected mean reversion.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 99.9, volume ratio 0.08 — same illiquid micro-cap spike pattern as the rest of the cluster; no real price discovery at $6.10.
uncommitted.reflection: Expected illiquid reversion; stale quote drifted marginally higher with zero real volume or price discovery.

uncommitted.rationale: 5d return +10,138% but 20d only +6.17% — implies the stock was at similar prices 20 days ago and just re-spiked; RSI 70.5 is the only non-extreme reading in the cluster but volume is 0.00, so there is no buying support.
uncommitted.reflection: Zero volume prevented both reversion and continuation; price anchored exactly where the session opened.

uncommitted.rationale: 9900% spike on RSI=55 suggests recent gap event; likely consolidation or pullback.
uncommitted.reflection: Gap-event consolidation was expected; price stalled flat rather than pulling back on the session.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 100, volume ratio 0.10 — same illiquid 10,000%+ spike pattern; SMA20 at $1.29 vs $21.70 close illustrates the data distortion.
uncommitted.reflection: Data distortion persisted; illiquidity prevented reversion as well as continuation.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 100, volume ratio 0.01 — effectively zero turnover at the quoted price; SMA20 of $0.59 vs close of $9.99 signals a stale/illiquid print.
uncommitted.reflection: Effectively zero turnover meant no price discovery in either direction; stale print held unchanged.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 99.9, volume ratio 0.00 — no volume whatsoever; price discovery is absent and any real seller would crater the quote.
uncommitted.reflection: Absent volume meant no sellers to confirm the reversion thesis; quote remained a stale artifact.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 53.1 is the least extreme in the cluster and 20d return is flat (-0.13%), but 5d +9,789% with 0.00 volume ratio means the spike has no real support; mild reversion expected.
uncommitted.reflection: No-volume spike lacked both selling pressure to revert and buying support to extend; price unchanged.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 99.9, volume ratio 0.20 — slightly higher relative volume than peers but still nowhere near sufficient to support a $315 close; reversion risk dominates.
uncommitted.reflection: Higher relative volume than peers still insufficient to move price; reversion stalled at flat.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 99.9, volume ratio 0.01 — gold-linked product at maximum overbought with negligible turnover; downside risk from profit-taking on any real volume day.
uncommitted.reflection: Negligible turnover meant no profit-taking materialised; downside thesis intact but unresolved.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 99.9, volume ratio 0.01 — same cluster characteristics; no tradeable liquidity at the quoted $298.95 level.
uncommitted.reflection: No tradeable liquidity; stale quote held near unchanged with no volume to drive reversion.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 99.9, volume ratio 0.00 — zero volume confirms this is a stale print, not an active market.
uncommitted.reflection: Zero-volume stale print confirmed; price drifted minimally with no real participants on either side.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 99.9, volume ratio 0.00 — no volume, maximally overbought; the defence-sector name does not redeem the data quality problem.
uncommitted.reflection: Sector name irrelevant; zero volume meant the overbought reversion signal had no mechanism to execute.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 99.8 with volume ratio 0.44 — the highest relative volume in the LSE spike cluster, but still well below what's needed to sustain a 9,000%+ move; modest reversion probability is higher than peers.
uncommitted.reflection: Highest cluster volume still couldn't sustain the extreme move; reversion expected but session closed flat.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 99.0, volume ratio 0.02 — near-zero volume on an 8,685% 5-day move; price has no bid support at current levels.
uncommitted.reflection: Near-zero bid support on an extreme 5-day surge; reversion thesis intact but not triggered on the day.

uncommitted.rationale: 5d +100% reversal from 20d -33%; recovery trade but modest near-term upside.
uncommitted.reflection: Expected recovery continuation; sellers resumed and erased gains, revealing the 5d bounce as a dead-cat.

uncommitted.rationale: Sustained move with RSI=79 (overbought); momentum fading, limited upside.
uncommitted.reflection: RSI-overbought stall played out as flat; momentum faded without the mild upside extension materialising.

uncommitted.rationale: Strong 20d +179% but overbought RSI=70; expect consolidation with mild upside.
uncommitted.reflection: 20d momentum carried through despite overbought RSI; upside exceeded the conservative consolidation estimate.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 100 on a genuine +65% move with 20× volume — the catalyst is real but unknown, and after a vertical single-leg surge of this magnitude profit-taking is the most probable next session outcome.
uncommitted.reflection: Real catalyst prevented profit-taking reversion; buyers absorbed supply and price closed near flat.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI=85 with accelerating move; very overbought, pullback likely.
uncommitted.reflection: Overbought RSI stalled price but buyers absorbed supply; pullback stopped at flat rather than declining.

uncommitted.rationale: RSI 30.2, below both MAs, -58% in 5 days, volume 0.14× — downtrend has no reversal catalyst and the trend is confirmed across all timeframes.
uncommitted.reflection: Downtrend confirmed but decelerated; low volume cushioned the fall short of the strong-down target.

uncommitted.rationale: X-account catalyst drove 51% move but cooling from 65% 20d; overbought RSI=79.
uncommitted.reflection: Expected cooling momentum to hold mild upside; RSI-overbought reversal flipped the session negative.

uncommitted.rationale: Accelerating 50% move but RSI=76 (overbought); continuation at risk.
uncommitted.reflection: Overbought RSI stalled momentum at flat; continuation failed as the rationale warned.

uncommitted.rationale: Sustained momentum but RSI=77 (overbought); limited intraday upside.
uncommitted.reflection: Overbought RSI capped the move; flatlined rather than extending momentum, inline with the warning.

uncommitted.rationale: Accelerating 46% move with RSI=60; good momentum signal without overbought extremes.
uncommitted.reflection: Non-overbought RSI suggested safe continuation; momentum reversed intraday without a clear catalyst.

uncommitted.rationale: 3× inverse semiconductor ETF with -65% 20-day return — same structural problem as SOXS.L; high volume (5×) on the decline confirms distribution, not a washout bottom.
uncommitted.reflection: High-volume distribution on inverse ETF confirmed; decline exceeded the target as selling accelerated.

uncommitted.rationale: Fresh fundamental negative (exiting Morocco gas asset, -33% on news), RSI 23, below both MAs — selling pressure from the catalyst has likely not fully cleared.
uncommitted.reflection: Fundamental catalyst and RSI 23 drove further decline; selling partially cleared in one session, not fully.

uncommitted.rationale: Strong uptrend but RSI=85 (very overbought); pullback risk high.
uncommitted.reflection: Very overbought RSI negated uptrend strength; pullback risk materialised as flat rather than a mild gain.

uncommitted.rationale: Accelerating 43% move with RSI=69; approaching overbought but still tradeable.
uncommitted.reflection: Overbought approach capped the move; price slipped negative rather than extending momentum.

uncommitted.rationale: Accelerating momentum (42% 5d > 31% 20d) with moderate RSI=53.
uncommitted.reflection: Moderate RSI and accelerating momentum didn't translate; price stalled flat with no follow-through.

uncommitted.rationale: Sustained move but RSI=74 (overbought); expect consolidation.
uncommitted.reflection: Overbought RSI=74 triggered consolidation as expected but extended past flat into a small loss.

uncommitted.rationale: Strong momentum but RSI=78 (very overbought); limited upside.
uncommitted.reflection: Rationale capped upside on RSI=78 overbought; underlying momentum blew through the signal and ran strongly higher.

uncommitted.rationale: Solar/AI energy theme with 40% move but cooling from 107% 20d; RSI=83 overbought.
uncommitted.reflection: 20d cooling from 107% confirmed deceleration; RSI=83 overbought capped any extension beyond flat.

uncommitted.rationale: Volatile reversal pattern (5d +40% vs 20d -22%); no clear directional bias.
uncommitted.reflection: No-direction bias from the 5d/20d reversal conflict correctly resolved to flat.

uncommitted.rationale: Accelerating momentum with moderate RSI=57; good risk/reward setup.
uncommitted.reflection: Assumed RSI=57 acceleration would continue; price reversed, suggesting the 5d surge had already exhausted buyers.

uncommitted.rationale: Clear downtrend (-39% 5d, -41% 20d), RSI=16; strong sell signal.
uncommitted.reflection: RSI=16 extreme oversold was read as sell continuation; instead triggered a sharp mean-reversion rally.

uncommitted.rationale: Sustained uptrend with RSI=69; approaching overbought but not extreme.
uncommitted.reflection: Approaching-overbought RSI=69 capped the uptrend; consolidation absorbed the predicted mild continuation.

uncommitted.rationale: Sustained move with RSI=78 (overbought); pullback expected.
uncommitted.reflection: RSI=78 overbought pressure held price flat; predicted mild upside failed to materialise.

uncommitted.rationale: Earnings call context with 37% move but RSI=81 very overbought; consolidation likely.
uncommitted.reflection: Earnings-driven momentum overrode RSI=81 overbought caution; mild upside prediction matched the continued move.

uncommitted.rationale: Accelerating move but RSI=76 (overbought); momentum fading.
uncommitted.reflection: RSI=76 overbought faded momentum as anticipated, capping any extension above flat.

uncommitted.rationale: 20d +142% >> 5d +33%; momentum significantly cooling.
uncommitted.reflection: 20d/5d deceleration played out; mild pullback landed just inside the flat classification.
